fact: The DGSN, Morocco's national security directorate, issued nearly 4.7 million electronic national ID cards in 2024 at its Rabat and Marrakech centres and ran the second phase of the electronic identity system, per its annual report.
source_slug: 2024-12-24 Morocco's DGSN issued 4.6 million electronic national IDs in 2024 (annual report)

fact: The deck says the Ministry of Interior is pursuing national technological autonomy for the RNP, with training in India and knowledge transfer, to reduce external dependence.

The deck says UM6P's MOSIP Centre of Excellence, a Moroccan university unit with 17 staff, holds a contract with the Ministry of Interior for L3 support, evolution of the MOSIP and RNP code and migration to the LTS version.
The deck says the RNP runs on MOSIP (version 1.1.5.x, being migrated to LTS), generalised to all 83 provinces in October 2022.
